name: Amzn-SearchBot
follows_en: Yes, changes may take about 24 hours

ips.note: Amazon publishes the Amzn-SearchBot IP addresses on a web page that shows the list as JSON, and links it from the Amazonbot documentation page.

ua: Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko; compatible; Amzn-SearchBot/0.1) Chrome/W.X.Y.Z Safari/537.36
vendor_quote: If robots.txt files don’t mention Amzn-SearchBot but allow other search bots, Amzn-SearchBot will crawl in accordance with the robots.txt directives given to other search bots.
what_en: Amzn-SearchBot is an Amazon crawler used to improve search experiences in Amazon products and services. Amazon says that allowing it makes your content eligible to appear in search experiences such as Alexa, and that it does not crawl content for generative AI model training. It is one of three Amazon user agents (Amazonbot, Amzn-SearchBot, Amzn-User) that Amazon documents on one page.
block_en: Amazon says automated crawling from its listed user agents respects the Robots Exclusion Protocol, honoring the user-agent and allow/disallow directives. Amazon says each user agent setting is independent of the others and may take about 24 hours to take effect. If robots.txt does not mention Amzn-SearchBot but allows other search bots, it follows the directives given to those other search bots.
compare_en: Amazonbot is used to improve Amazon products and services and may be used to train Amazon AI models, while Amzn-SearchBot is for search experiences and Amazon says it does not crawl for generative AI model training.
notes: Page says 'Chrome/W.X.Y.Z' as a placeholder; kept verbatim. IP page is HTML wrapping a JSON list: 816 prefixes (all /32), creationTime 2026-09-08, per our parse of the page; not stated in the JSON fields because brief says no count for HTML. Doc says crawlers fetch host-level robots.txt or use a cached copy from the last 30 days, and do not support crawl-delay.
answer_en: Amzn-SearchBot is an Amazon crawler used to improve search experiences such as Alexa. Amazon says allowing it makes your content eligible to appear there, and that it does not crawl for generative AI model training. Its setting is independent of Amazonbot and Amzn-User, and a change can take about 24 hours.
